headline: Russo downs Liverpool in WSL as City slip to second
paragraphs: Arsenal's women beat Liverpool 2-1 at Anfield in the Women's Super League, Alessia Russo scoring both goals. It is the best-corroborated story in today's feed: Sky, the Guardian and BBC Sport all covered the match independently. BBC Sport said the win moved Arsenal up to seventh in the table; the Guardian described it as a lift for under-pressure head coach Renee Slegers, whose side had been struggling for results.

On the men's side, Liverpool won 3-1 at Crystal Palace -- Alexis Mac Allister and Florian Wirtz scored, Wirtz ending a 12-game Premier League goal drought -- a result also confirmed separately by Sky, the Guardian and BBC Sport. It was Palace's fourth straight league defeat, per Sky. Manchester City dropped to second after Brighton beat Brentford 2-0, reported independently by Sky and the Guardian. BBC Sport added that City defender Marc Guehi needs a scan on a hip complaint before this week's England call-up.
